draft_text: We have the link on file, so your balances should keep moving through the refresh cycle while you renew consent.
label_basis: The draft implies balance refresh will continue even though consent is expired and the route is degraded, so the context does not support future refresh.

draft_text: After you authorize again, access will settle back into place and the app will show the latest account view.
label_basis: The draft promises restored access and a latest account view while consent is revoked, the route is unavailable, and fallback is blocked.

draft_text: Your connection is healthy on our side and account activity can proceed as usual.
label_basis: The draft asserts a healthy connection and normal activity even though the route status is degraded.

draft_text: Although this partner view is turned off, your account will keep refreshing normally in the background.
label_basis: The draft claims normal background refreshing despite the partner scope being disabled.

draft_text: We will check again this afternoon and your account data should populate once the institution details arrive.
label_basis: The draft gives a same-day refresh expectation while institution metadata and route status are unknown.

draft_text: No partner ID is on the request, but the connection can finish automatically after our next pass.
label_basis: The draft promises automatic completion even though the partner_id required to evaluate scope is missing.

draft_text: The consent step still needs attention. Your account view is queued and should fill in after that step is done.
label_basis: The second sentence implies account data will appear after consent completion while insufficient consent is a closed gate.

draft_text: Service is unavailable right now. Once the route is reachable, the balances will line up without another action.
label_basis: The second sentence promises balance restoration without another action while the route is unavailable and fallback is blocked.

draft_text: We are waiting on authorization status, and the account data is on track to appear once that check clears.
label_basis: The draft says account data is on track to appear even though authorization status is unknown.

draft_text: The institution recently changed names, but the connection itself is stable and ready for normal account activity.
label_basis: The draft asserts the connection is stable and ready for normal activity while the route is degraded.

draft_text: Your permission needs renewal; after you confirm it, the feed will resume from where it left off.
label_basis: The draft promises the feed will resume after renewal while expired consent only supports a consent gate.

draft_text: The partner scope is not available for this request, but the background link will continue carrying fresh account information.
label_basis: The draft claims continued background data flow despite disabled partner scope and degraded route status.

draft_text: Even without the institution and partner identifiers, the saved profile should let us complete the account sync later today.
label_basis: The draft gives a completion timeframe while both institution and partner identifiers are missing.

draft_text: Once you complete the consent prompt, this service interruption should clear and your account details will catch up.
label_basis: The draft links consent completion to outage resolution and account catch-up despite insufficient consent, unavailable route, and blocked fallback.

draft_text: We cannot refresh account data until consent is confirmed again, and the current view may be stale.
label_basis: The draft states the required consent gate and only warns that the current view may be stale.

draft_text: The account view is a snapshot from the last completed retrieval, not a live balance feed.
label_basis: The draft frames the data as a past snapshot and explicitly denies that it is live.

draft_text: I will follow up when the synthetic status check changes; that follow-up is not a promise that account data has refreshed.
label_basis: The draft commits only to a support follow-up and explicitly says it is not a data-refresh promise.

draft_text: Balance data is not real-time and may be stale depending on the institution refresh cycle.
label_basis: The draft denies real-time status and uses a stale-data hedge rather than a freshness promise.

draft_text: The primary account route is degraded, so refresh timing is not guaranteed.
label_basis: The draft plainly discloses degraded route status and negates any timing guarantee.

draft_text: Consent needs to be completed before any account data access can proceed.
label_basis: The draft states the consent prerequisite without promising timing, refresh, or automatic access.

draft_text: The institution name changed, so the linked view may show a transition label while data timing remains variable.
label_basis: The draft explains the rebrand and uses variable timing language without promising data freshness or continuity.

draft_text: We cannot continue account access while consent is revoked; please re-authorize before any data request is attempted.
label_basis: The draft blocks account access under revoked consent and makes no restoration promise.

draft_text: We need the institution identifier before checking connection status, so no refresh timing can be given yet.
label_basis: The draft refuses to provide refresh timing because required institution metadata is missing.

draft_text: We can review the request after the partner identifier is supplied; until then, I cannot say whether linking will complete.
label_basis: The draft conditions review on receiving partner_id and explicitly avoids predicting completion.

draft_text: The service route is unavailable and fallback is blocked, so we cannot confirm when account data will be available.
label_basis: The draft discloses route unavailability and blocked fallback while refusing to give availability timing.

draft_text: Authorization status is not confirmed, so please confirm consent before we make any account data claim.
label_basis: The draft treats unknown authorization as a consent gate and avoids any account data claim.

draft_text: If monitoring shows a new status, support can send an update; this does not guarantee a data refresh or restored access.
label_basis: The draft promises only a support update and explicitly negates refresh or restoration guarantees.

draft_text: Customers may see recently retrieved account information; it should be treated as a historical snapshot, not current activity.
label_basis: The draft uses cautious snapshot language and denies that the view represents current activity.
